[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 15
- Description: Shared Próspera entity documents with counterparty exploring DAO infrastructure as trade-finance bridge
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1714
  
  Details:
  **What was done**
  
  Spent 15 minutes sharing the TrueSight DAO LLC (Próspera ZEDE) entity document set with a counterparty entity that is exploring use of the DAO's infrastructure as a bridge for the financial flows of its trade.
  
  Documents shared (the standard formation/governance instrument set for the Próspera LLC):
  
  - **Certificate of Organization** — TrueSight DAO LLC, LLC formed under RCLC § 3707 (ULLCA), Próspera ZEDE, Roatán, Islas de la Bahía, Honduras. 4 pp, bilingual EN/ES, organizer-signed 2026-07-07, "Approved" stamp, PZ seal.
  - **Operating Agreement — FINAL v1.0** — the executed By-Laws / internal governing instrument, 15 pp, DAZ-sealed, effective 2026-07-01.
  - **ePróspera "Entity Application Approved"** notice, 2026-07-07 — registry acceptance evidence.
  
  **Why**
  
  A counterparty entity is evaluating whether the DAO's corporate infrastructure — a Próspera ZEDE LLC with a documented formation instrument, a sealed operating agreement, and a governance model binding entity units to TDG holdings on the Main Ledger — can serve as the legal vehicle through which the financial flows of its trade pass. Sharing the formation and governance instruments is the transparency step that lets that counterparty's counsel and counterparties assess suitability. This mirrors the existing triangular trade structure described in the Operating Agreement Recitals (Brazil Export Partners → Company (Próspera) → U.S. Import Partner, TrueTech Inc), which is the precedent other entities are being pointed at.
  
  **Note on the record**
  
  The receiving entity is not named in this submission — the sharing occurred off-platform and I have no verified record of the recipient. Recorded this way rather than asserting a counterparty name that cannot be evidenced. Any downstream KYC / onboarding record for that entity should name it explicitly when it is opened.
  
  **Documents are held at**
  
  - Public (redacted): `TrueSightDAO/notarizations/` — certificate, operating agreement v1.0, ePróspera approval
  - Index: `TrueSightDAO/notarizations/ENTITY_LEGAL_DOCS.md`
  - Private full-fidelity originals: `TrueSightDAO/notarizations-raw/originals/`
  
  **GitHub / Pull requests**
  
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1714
  
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 25.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
